name: Octop v1 Multi-User AI Assistant
description: Self-hosted multi-agent AI assistant for teams, with chat apps and tools.

PORT.description: Port of the Octop dashboard and API. Railway's healthcheck and the public domain use it; keep 8088 unless you also change the domain's target port.

OCTOP_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Login name of the first admin, created before the dashboard opens. Random on purpose: five wrong passwords lock a username for 15 minutes.

OCTOP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password (min. 12 characters with letters and digits), generated at deploy. Change it here and redeploy to reset it; a password changed in the dashboard is kept until then.

OCTOP_ADMIN_DISPLAY_NAME.description: Display name of the first admin (first boot only).

OCTOP_ADMIN_LOCALE.description: Language of the first admin's dashboard and default experts: en or zh (first boot only; each user can change it later).

OCTOP_DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL control-plane database (users, experts, channels, cron, settings, encrypted keys) and agent memory. Empty = SQLite on the volume.

OCTOP_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for dashboard times and cron schedules, e.g. Europe/Istanbul (upstream default is Asia/Shanghai).

OCTOP_SECURITY_DEFAULTS.description: strict = on the first boot, store a policy with tool approval on and the shell guard set to require approval. upstream = keep upstream defaults (approval off, guard warns only).

OCTOP_ENABLE_MOBILE.description: Remote Android (redroid) needs Docker and kernel binder support, which Railway does not offer; kept off.

OCTOP_LOG_TO_STDOUT.description: true = forward Octop's application log (agents, channels, cron) from /data/.octop/logs to Railway's log view.

OCTOP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Octop log level: debug, info, warning or error.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Octop gets to stop agents, channels and the database pool before a redeploy kills it.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGUSER.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

PGPASSWORD.description: Required variable for the Data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when the image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to the Postgres database over the private network.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to the Postgres DB.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Password to connect to the DB (generated).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to shut down cleanly.
